# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Embla carousel. The orientation reaches CarouselContent, CarouselItem,
  # CarouselPrevious and CarouselNext through the render context, so their
  # orientation classes are plain utilities a caller's class can override
  # (shadcn's cn behavior).
  class Carousel < Base
    VALID_ORIENTATIONS = %i[horizontal vertical].freeze

    def initialize(orientation: :horizontal, options: {}, **user_attrs)
      @orientation = orientation.to_s.to_sym
      raise ArgumentError, "orientation must be :horizontal or :vertical" unless VALID_ORIENTATIONS.include?(@orientation)
      @options = options

      super(**user_attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_carousel]
      context[:ruby_ui_carousel] = {orientation: @orientation}
      div(**attrs, &)
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_carousel] = previous
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: ["relative group", orientation_classes],
        role: "region",
        aria_roledescription: "carousel",
        data: {
          slot: "carousel",
          controller: "ruby-ui--carousel",
          ruby_ui__carousel_options_value: default_options.merge(@options).to_json,
          action: %w[
            keydown.right->ruby-ui--carousel#scrollNext:prevent
            keydown.left->ruby-ui--carousel#scrollPrev:prevent
          ]
        }
      }
    end

    def default_options
      {
        axis: (@orientation == :horizontal) ? "x" : "y"
      }
    end

    def orientation_classes
      (@orientation == :horizontal) ? "is-horizontal" : "is-vertical"
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CarouselContent < Base
    ORIENTATION_CLASSES = {horizontal: "-ml-4", vertical: "-mt-4 flex-col"}.freeze

    def view_template(&)
      div(class: "overflow-hidden", data: {slot: "carousel-content", ruby_ui__carousel_target: "viewport"}) do
        div(**attrs, class: TAILWIND_MERGER.merge([ORIENTATION_CLASSES.fetch(orientation), attrs[:class]]), &)
      end
    end

    private

    def orientation
      context.dig(:ruby_ui_carousel, :orientation) || :horizontal
    end

    def default_attrs
      {class: "flex"}
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CarouselItem < Base
    ORIENTATION_CLASSES = {horizontal: "pl-4", vertical: "pt-4"}.freeze

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, class: TAILWIND_MERGER.merge([ORIENTATION_CLASSES.fetch(orientation), attrs[:class]]), &)
    end

    private

    def orientation
      context.dig(:ruby_ui_carousel, :orientation) || :horizontal
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "group",
        aria_roledescription: "slide",
        data: {slot: "carousel-item"},
        class: "min-w-0 shrink-0 grow-0 basis-full"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CarouselNext < Base
    ORIENTATION_CLASSES = {
      horizontal: "-right-12 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2",
      vertical: "-bottom-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90"
    }.freeze

    def view_template
      # slot! overrides Button's data-slot="button" instead of appending to it.
      Button(**attrs, class: [ORIENTATION_CLASSES.fetch(orientation), attrs[:class]], data: {**attrs[:data], slot!: "carousel-next"}) do
        icon
        span(class: "sr-only") { "Next slide" }
      end
    end

    private

    def orientation
      context.dig(:ruby_ui_carousel, :orientation) || :horizontal
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        variant: :outline,
        icon: true,
        class: "absolute h-8 w-8 rounded-full touch-manipulation",
        disabled: true,
        data: {
          action: "click->ruby-ui--carousel#scrollNext",
          ruby_ui__carousel_target: "nextButton"
        }
      }
    end

    # lucide chevron-right, mirrored in RTL when horizontal.
    def icon
      svg(
        width: "24",
        height: "24",
        viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        aria_hidden: "true",
        # Mirrored in RTL only when horizontal: the vertical axis doesn't
        # depend on reading direction.
        class: (orientation == :horizontal) ? "rtl:rotate-180" : nil
      ) do |s|
        s.path(d: "m9 18 6-6-6-6")
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class CarouselPrevious < Base
    ORIENTATION_CLASSES = {
      horizontal: "-left-12 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2",
      vertical: "-top-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90"
    }.freeze

    def view_template
      # slot! overrides Button's data-slot="button" instead of appending to it.
      Button(**attrs, class: [ORIENTATION_CLASSES.fetch(orientation), attrs[:class]], data: {**attrs[:data], slot!: "carousel-previous"}) do
        icon
        span(class: "sr-only") { "Previous slide" }
      end
    end

    private

    def orientation
      context.dig(:ruby_ui_carousel, :orientation) || :horizontal
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        variant: :outline,
        icon: true,
        class: "absolute h-8 w-8 rounded-full touch-manipulation",
        disabled: true,
        data: {
          action: "click->ruby-ui--carousel#scrollPrev",
          ruby_ui__carousel_target: "prevButton"
        }
      }
    end

    # lucide chevron-left, mirrored in RTL when horizontal.
    def icon
      svg(
        width: "24",
        height: "24",
        viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        aria_hidden: "true",
        # Mirrored in RTL only when horizontal: the vertical axis doesn't
        # depend on reading direction.
        class: (orientation == :horizontal) ? "rtl:rotate-180" : nil
      ) do |s|
        s.path(d: "m15 18-6-6 6-6")
      end
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Carousel

A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
Carousel(aria_label: "Numbers", class: "w-full max-w-xs") do
  CarouselContent do
    5.times do |index|
      CarouselItem do
        div(class: "p-1") do
          Card(class: "py-0") do
            CardContent(class: "flex aspect-square items-center justify-center p-6") do
              span(class: "text-4xl font-semibold") { index + 1 }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  CarouselPrevious()
  CarouselNext()
end
```

### Sizes

```ruby
Carousel(aria_label: "Numbers", class: "w-full max-w-sm") do
  CarouselContent do
    5.times do |index|
      CarouselItem(class: "md:basis-1/2 lg:basis-1/3") do
        div(class: "p-1") do
          Card(class: "py-0") do
            CardContent(class: "flex aspect-square items-center justify-center p-6") do
              span(class: "text-3xl font-semibold") { index + 1 }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  CarouselPrevious()
  CarouselNext()
end
```

### Spacing

```ruby
Carousel(aria_label: "Numbers", class: "w-full max-w-sm") do
  CarouselContent(class: "-ml-1") do
    5.times do |index|
      CarouselItem(class: "pl-1 md:basis-1/2 lg:basis-1/3") do
        div(class: "p-1") do
          Card(class: "py-0") do
            CardContent(class: "flex aspect-square items-center justify-center p-6") do
              span(class: "text-2xl font-semibold") { index + 1 }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  CarouselPrevious()
  CarouselNext()
end
```

### Orientation

```ruby
Carousel(orientation: :vertical, options: {align: "start"}, aria_label: "Numbers", class: "w-full max-w-xs") do
  CarouselContent(class: "-mt-1 h-[200px]") do
    5.times do |index|
      CarouselItem(class: "pt-1 md:basis-1/2") do
        div(class: "p-1") do
          Card(class: "py-0") do
            CardContent(class: "flex items-center justify-center p-6") do
              span(class: "text-3xl font-semibold") { index + 1 }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  CarouselPrevious()
  CarouselNext()
end
```

### Loop

```ruby
Carousel(options: {loop: true}, aria_label: "Numbers", class: "w-full max-w-xs") do
  CarouselContent do
    5.times do |index|
      CarouselItem do
        div(class: "p-1") do
          Card(class: "py-0") do
            CardContent(class: "flex aspect-square items-center justify-center p-6") do
              span(class: "text-4xl font-semibold") { index + 1 }
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  CarouselPrevious()
  CarouselNext()
end
```
